question: What must an Express Entry employment / reference letter contain?

claims.text: The reference or experience letter should be an official document printed on company letterhead.
claims.quote: should be an official document printed on company letterhead

claims.text: The reference or experience letter must include the applicant's name, the company's contact information (address, telephone number and email address), and the name, title and signature of the immediate supervisor or personnel officer at the company.
claims.quote: (must include the applicant’s name, the company’s contact information [address, telephone number and email address], and the name, title and signature of the immediate supervisor or personnel officer at the company)

claims.text: The reference or experience letter should indicate all positions held while employed at the company.
claims.quote: should indicate all positions held while employed at the company

claims.text: The reference or experience letter must include the following details: job title, duties and responsibilities, job status (if current job), dates worked for the company, number of work hours per week and annual salary plus benefits.
claims.quote: must include the following details: job title, duties and responsibilities, job status (if current job), dates worked for the company, number of work hours per week and annual salary plus benefits

claims.text: The submitted employment reference letter contains all mandatory elements—including letterhead, applicant identity, company contact details, supervisor signatory, positions held, job duties, status, dates, weekly hours, and annual salary plus benefits—and meets requirements.
claims.quote: a reference or experience letter from the employer

basis: Document evaluation for opaque case ID 04597da96ea65edadb49ead722f7cf40 under upload-slot employment_reference_letter: verdict is meets_requirements.

The document clearly identifies the applicant by full name and specifies the position held, job title, detailed job duties, employment start and end dates, full-time status, weekly working hours, and annual salary plus benefits.
The document features a complete supervisor signature block with the supervisor name, title, contact information, and physical/digital signature.
